Owner group requires authentication and OwnerAuthorizeAsync audits non-owner denials before returning 403.

next_slice.summary: Correct audit outcome mapping so validation/conflict 4xx responses are failure while 401/403 remain denied, and add focused integration assertions for owner/admin/viewer and CSRF paths.

result: Requested tests pass and the audit/owner-denial changes are present. Owner-only endpoints now use an authenticated group filter that audits non-owner 403 denials; generic viewer-denied mutations are also audited. Mutation responses are classified by status, with 5xx=failure and 4xx=denied. CSRF filters remain on unsafe authenticated/account routes, and audit records contain no passwords, hashes, cookies, CSRF values, or request bodies. One semantic gap remains: ordinary validation/client errors (400/409) are classified as denied rather than failure, so failure outcomes are not consistently represented.
